title: Synthesis, spectroscopic characterization, and DFT-assisted molecular docking analysis of novel 1,3,4-oxadiazole–1,2,3-triazole hybrids with antimicrobial and cytotoxicity potential
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6314-6337
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09082B, Paper
Open Access

Darshna K. Lakhnotra, Jay B. Maheta, Yogesh O. Bhola, Bhavesh N. Socha, Nargis H. Shaikh, Prince A. Dave, Sureshkumar B. Koradiya
Novel heterocyclic derivatives were synthesized and evaluated via DFT, molecular docking and bioassays. Compounds 10i, 11b and 11c showed strong EGFR inhibition, cytotoxicity and antimicrobial activity, highlighting their potential as multifunctional therapeutic leads.
